newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: IWP pays 38mlnstg for 80pct Constance Carrol.
newsitem.headline: IWP pays 38mlnstg for 80pct Constance Carrol.

text.p: IWP International Plc said on Friday that it had acquired 80 percent of Constance Carroll Holdings Ltd for 38.5 million pounds sterling.
The company said in a statement that the acqusition was made by its British subsidiary, IWP (UK) Holdings Plc.

IWP has also entered into a Put and Call option agreement with the vendors under which it can require the vendors to sell the remaining 20 percent at an exercise price to be determined by reference to the average profits before tax of Constance Carroll for the financial year ending March 31, 1988.
Under the agreement, the vendors can also require IWP UK to acquire the 20 percent stake.
Constance Carroll is one of the largest manufacturers in Europe of colour cosmetics and personal care aerosols and also makes fragrances and skin care products.
Based in Skelmersdale, Lancashire, the company's products are sold in Western and Eastern Europe, the Middle East, Australia and the far East.
The majority of Constance Carroll's sales are to wholesalers with export sales accounting for two thirds of turnover.
